channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: World Blitz C'ship: Arjun Erigaisi stuns Magnus Carlsen; joint leader after 13 rounds
item.description: Arjun won 10 points from 13 games and now shares the top spot with Fabiano Caruana and Maxime Vachier-Lagrave.

item.title: WPL 2026: Australian all-rounder Ashleigh Gardner to continue as captain of Gujarat Giants
item.description: Gardner led the Giants for their first-ever top-3 finish in the last edition of WPL.

item.title: India Open 2026 moves to IG Indoor Stadium as tickets go on sale
item.description: India’s flagship badminton tournament shifts to a larger venue in New Delhi, with early-bird ticket discounts announced ahead of the January event.

item.title: WPL 2026: Elysse Perry, Annabel Sutherland withdraw citing personal reasons
item.description: Meanwhile, Tara Norris is selected in the US National team for T20 World Cup Qualifiers, which will clash with WPL.

item.title: IWL 2026: East Bengal humble SESA FA; Sribhumi face first defeat of the season
item.description: NITA FA maintained the top place on the league table, while Gokulam Kerala handed Kickstart FC its 4th consecutive defeat.

item.title: Stability is key for Lakshya Sen in future: Peter Gade
item.description: Danish Badminton legend and elite coach Peter Gade stresses on the importance of consistency in an exclusive chat with The Bridge.

item.title: Ranchi Royals hammer Shrachi Bengal Tigers 5–0 in commanding Hero HIL win
item.description: Lucina von der Heyde scores twice as Ranchi Royals register their first victory of the Women’s Hero Hockey India League season.

item.title: Sports Ministry forms Abhinav Bindra-led task force to professionalise Indian sports administration
item.description: The Task Force in its 170-page recommendation proposes a comprehensive roadmap to professionalise the Indian sports ecosystem.

item.title: India Women complete clean sweep against Sri Lanka with 15-run win in final T20I
item.description: Deepti Sharma becomes the highest wicket-taker in Women’s T20I history as India finish the series unbeaten.

item.title: GM Arjun Erigaisi clinches World Blitz Chess C'ship bronze medal
item.description: Indian grandmaster follows up World Rapid bronze with another medal, reinforcing his status among chess’s elite.
